title: Cover and Asset
author: Odile Coldharbour
blurb: Jonah Okonkwo, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
